verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that tie each payout to its underlying transactions and adjustments. The reports itemize gross, taxes, Paddle fees, chargeback fees and retained fees, and can be generated via API for accounting systems. Nothing in the evidence shows a finance-ops user can control the payout schedule (frequency, timing or thresholds), so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: payout schedule control, explicit refund line-item breakdown per payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: Payout reconciliation reports help you reconcile payouts to transactions and adjustments to understand how your payout amounts are calculated.
Review itemized gross, taxes, Paddle, chargeback, and retained fees in both transaction and balance currencies
Generate detailed reports that connect your Paddle payouts to the underlying transaction movements for accurate financial reconciliation.
